description: Only invoices that have line items are averaged over.

a.request: Across the invoices that have at least one line item, what is the average of each invoice's mean line-item `product_price` (missing prices ignored; an invoice with no non-missing price has no mean and is skipped), and what is the average number of line items per invoice? Return a single row with these two values, unrounded.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(invoice_mean_price) AS average_invoice_mean_product_price, AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_items_per_invoice FROM (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) AS invoice_mean_price, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number) AS invoice_summary;

c.request: Per invoice, what is the average of the invoice's mean line-item `product_price` (missing prices ignored; an invoice with no non-missing price has no mean and is skipped), and what is the average number of line items on an invoice? Return a single row with these two values, unrounded. Only invoices that have line items are averaged over.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(mean_product_price) AS average_invoice_mean_product_price, AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_items_per_invoice FROM (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) AS mean_product_price, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number) AS per_invoice;

b.request: Return one unrounded row: the average of each invoice’s mean non-missing line-item `product_price`, excluding invoices with no non-missing price, and the average line-item count across all invoices with at least one line item.
b.sql: SELECT (SELECT AVG(mean_price) FROM (SELECT AVG(product_price) AS mean_price FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0)) AS average_invoice_mean_price, (SELECT AVG(line_item_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number)) AS average_line_item_count
b.raw: Return one unrounded row: the average of each invoice’s mean non-missing line-item `product_price`, excluding invoices with no non-missing price, and the average line-item count across all invoices with at least one line item.

d.request: Return one unrounded row containing the average of each invoice’s mean non-null line-item `product_price`, excluding invoices with no non-null prices, and the average line-item count across invoices with at least one line item.
d.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.product_price) AS mean_price, COUNT(ili.invoice_number) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) SELECT AVG(mean_price) AS average_invoice_mean_price, AVG(CASE WHEN line_item_count > 0 THEN line_item_count END) AS average_line_item_count FROM invoice_stats
